faqs.a:
The city manager is hereby authorized and directed to provide a means for and to proceed
               with the introduction of the fluoride ion into the water supply through the city water
               treatment plants in such quantities as are required to maintain throughout the pipe
               distribution system a fluoride ion concentration that meets the recommendations set
               forth by the State of Colorado Department of Health and Environment.
(Code 1981, § 33-44; Ord. No. 2574, § 1, 11-21-1988;
Ord. No. 4246, § 1, 1-3-2011
)
